newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's CDC sees slight growth slowdown in Q3.
newsitem.headline: France's CDC sees slight growth slowdown in Q3.

text.p: French state bank Caisse des Depots et Consignations (CDC) said on Monday its latest estimates for French economic growth showed a slight slowdown in the third quarter but the overall growth pattern appeared smooth.
The CDC said its estimate for growth in the third quarter, adjusting for seasonal variations and the number of working days, was 0.5 percent, down from 0.6 percent in the second quarter.
It said in a statement its second quarter estimate was revised down from 0.7 percent last month "primarily due to the confirmation of a decrease in domestic demand in France".
The CDC said the positive impact on growth from external demand, exchange rates and interest rate spreads would diminish in the third quarter but the overall growth pattern "looks smooth".
The bank said its estimates were based on a synthetic leading indicator.
